findings.body: SQL injection: `sort` is interpolated directly into the ORDER BY clause. Use an allow-list of column names instead of raw concatenation.
findings.suggestedFix: Map `sort` through an allow-list before it reaches the SQL, e.g. `const col = ({name:'name',created:'created_at'})[sort] ?? 'created_at'`, and interpolate `col`.

findings.body: The LIKE term concatenation looks like SQL injection; the search term flows into the query.
findings.suggestedFix: No clean fix — the term is already bound as the `$1` parameter, so there is nothing to change here.

hotspots.reason: ORDER BY clause built from an untrusted sort parameter via string interpolation.

evidence: src/api/search.ts: ORDER BY is built from an untrusted sort parameter, an injection vector.
